title: ImpactAssessorItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-planning-impact-assessor. Like Phase 1's other agents (e.g. L1-requirements-elicitor), items carry full facts, not Phase 0-style meta-point summaries: every field here is already a short, atomic, factual statement (a CI's touch/no-touch finding, a component's blast-radius rationale, an external dependency's exact wording) that downstream agents (L1-planning-dependency-mapper, L1-planning-backlog-prioritizer) need verbatim to build a dependency graph or prioritize backlog items, not a further-condensed gloss. The artifact (impact-assessment.md) still exists as the fully-formatted, human-readable document (header table, prose framing of the Existing-System Impact narrative, etc.) — items restate the same facts in structured, queryable form, not a condensation of them. capability_check is a field not present in any sibling agent, because this agent's methodology runs two distinct checks in sequence, both required: a service-catalog capability-duplication check at the SERVICE grain (capability_check), then a CMDB configuration-item technical-touch check at the CI grain (existing_system_impact[]), cross-referenced against kb-L1-enterprise-architecture's narrative for why. external_dependencies[].description is kept in FULL (not condensed) since L1-planning-dependency-mapper needs the exact wording to build graph nodes/edges from it directly.

existing_system_impact.description: One entry per CI in the CMDB relevant to a proposed component. Empty array ONLY if the CMDB is genuinely empty (no parent enterprise) — never omit a relevant CI's row because it turned out not to be touched; 'not touched, by architecture decision' is itself a required finding.

components.description: One entry per requirement in prd.md. Every FR must appear here at least once — a requirement with no identifiable component is itself a finding, not an omission.

external_dependencies.description: Every third-party system, partner, or vendor a component depends on that is NOT one of the org's existing internal systems, including anything newly surfaced by checking existing_system_impact above. Empty array (not omitted) if genuinely none.

summary.description: What was checked against the service catalog, in full — which candidate service(s) were compared against the proposed capability, not a vague 'checked the catalog' claim.

matched_service_id.description: The closest existing service_id found in the catalog, even if it is NOT a duplicate — name the nearest candidate rather than reporting null whenever the catalog is non-empty. null only if the catalog itself is genuinely empty (no parent enterprise).

is_duplicate.description: true only if an existing service already provides materially the same capability this product proposes — a genuine duplicate-build risk. false (the common case) still requires matched_service_id to name what was checked, per summary/rationale.

rationale.description: Full text — specifically why matched_service_id is, or is not, a duplicate (different operating model, user population, missing capability, etc.), not a formality.

how_or_why_not.description: Full text — the specific integration if touched, or the specific reason it's excluded if not. Cross-checked against kb-L1-enterprise-architecture's narrative; a mismatch between what the CMDB shows and what the KB claims is itself a finding, stated here, not silently reconciled.

related_components.description: FR-NNN ids or component names this CI relates to. Empty array is valid (e.g. a CI excluded from touch with no directly related component, only a resulting external dependency).

blast_radius.description: Per this agent's embedded Blast Radius Classification guide (prompt S4, not a KB): Low = isolated/independently deployable, nothing depends on its internals; Medium = other components depend on it but it is not compliance/legal-critical; High = compliance/legal-critical or a core critical-path service.

rationale.description: Full text — why this radius, e.g. 'on critical path' or 'isolated, independently deployable'.

description.description: Full text, not condensed — L1-planning-dependency-mapper builds graph nodes/edges directly from this exact wording.

related_components.description: FR-NNN ids or component names this dependency is required for.

newly_surfaced.description: true if this dependency was newly discovered by this assessment's existing_system_impact checks (not visible at vision/requirements/PRD stage) — this is exactly what the Existing-System Impact check exists to catch.
